title: Work well, cute shapes
date: Reviewed in the United States on April 7, 2026
review: These are working very well to catch the gnats around the dirt of my lime tree and bush inside. I can’t believe how many gnats they have caught. I like the different shapes. I used the flowers at the beginning and changed to the chicks for Easter!  They are made of plastic which makes it easier to stick in the dirt and are very sticky. You just hold on to the bottom and peel off the top paper on each side. I was really surprised how well they work.
